SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN rs.store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) at_web, COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) d
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22' AND r.sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<>900))

WITH sold AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type ft, SUM(f.net_amount) net, COUNT(*) n
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key AND s.store_id=900
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY ALL),
ret AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_period, o.fulfilment_type ft, rs.store_id=900 AS at_web, SUM(r.refund_net) refund, COUNT(*) n
 FROM fact_return_line r
 JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
 JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT 'sold' k, fiscal_period, ft, NULL at_web, net v, n FROM sold UNION ALL SELECT 'ret', fiscal_period, ft, at_web, refund, n FROM ret ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) gross_sold, SUM(r.returns_net) ret, SUM(r.net_sales) net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_net AS (
    -- web sales on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- web returns (booked to the web shop) reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, w.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN n.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END), 2) AS cc_net,
       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_net n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
